---
title: Compare regions with less ink than bars
description: A lollipop draws a stem and a dot per value, so a reader compares positions on one scale.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## North grew while South shrank

These illustrative order counts compare two years in four regions. Each dot sits at its value on the shared scale; the stem joins it to zero, and a negative value hangs below.

```chart
type: lollipop
title: North grew while South lost orders
subtitle: Orders per region and year
data:
  inline:
    - {region: North, year: "2025", orders: 120}
    - {region: North, year: "2026", orders: 150}
    - {region: South, year: "2025", orders: 90}
    - {region: South, year: "2026", orders: 70}
    - {region: East, year: "2025", orders: -20}
    - {region: East, year: "2026", orders: 45}
    - {region: West, year: "2025", orders: 60}
    - {region: West, year: "2026", orders: 65}
encoding: {x: region, y: orders, color: year}
axes:
  y: {label: Orders}
```

*Source: Illustrative values. East ended 2025 below zero.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each region's value.
